description_en: Downgrades a video call to a voice call
description_zh: 从视频通话降级到语音通话
name: DegradeVideoFile

parameters.help_en: The call ID. You can obtain the CallId from the response parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo) operation
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The media type. Set the value to video
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message.

The value is a string that is 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number that receives the voice notification
parameters.help_zh: 接收语音通知的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number
